Security & Compliance

Technical and security background of Intune Assistant to support internal review, onboarding, and approval by security and compliance teams

Enterprise Grade SecurityZero-Trust ArchitectureMinimal Data Storage

Enterprise-Grade Security by Design

Intune Assistant follows Microsoft's Zero-Trust and Least-Privilege principles, ensuring your organization's security posture remains uncompromised.

Zero-Trust Architecture

All authentication via Microsoft Entra ID with delegated permissions only

No Application Permissions

No system accounts or application-only permissions - all actions on behalf of user

Minimal Data Storage

Only tenant ID and domain stored - no user or configuration data

Role-Based Access

Respects existing Intune and Entra ID role assignments

Short-Lived Tokens

Delegated tokens with automatic expiration and refresh

Customer Control

Full control over consent, access restrictions, and revocation

Key Security Benefits
No privileged access required
Customer retains full control
All actions are auditable
Microsoft-compliant architecture
Revocable access anytime
Minimal attack surface
